question_template.it: Esiste un controllo diretto o una delega operativa documentata tra {source} e {target} oltre al tramite di {bridge}?
question_template.en: Is there documented direct control or operational delegation between {source} and {target} beyond the intermediary {bridge}?

rules.rationale: Transitive control chains across corporate or organizational intermediaries are valid discovery questions when temporally overlapping.

question_template.it: La proprietà di {source} su {bridge} si estende in un controllo documentato su {target}?
question_template.en: Does {source}'s ownership of {bridge} extend into documented control over {target}?

rules.rationale: Ownership of a controlling intermediary warrants checking whether beneficial control reaches the target.

question_template.it: Esistono evidenze che {source} abbia autorizzato o incaricato direttamente {target} tramite {bridge}?
question_template.en: Is there evidence that {source} directly authorized or tasked {target} through {bridge}?

rules.rationale: Control over an entity that commissioned an act raises a valid verification question about upstream authorization.

question_template.it: Esiste una fornitura diretta o una dipendenza critica tra {source} e {target} oltre alla catena tramite {bridge}?
question_template.en: Is there a direct supply link or critical dependency between {source} and {target} beyond the chain through {bridge}?

rules.rationale: Multi-tier supply chains are valid discovery paths for dependency and bypass verification.

question_template.it: Esiste una collaborazione operativa documentata tra {source} e {target}, entrambi legati a {bridge}?
question_template.en: Is there documented operational collaboration between {source} and {target}, both linked to {bridge}?

rules.rationale: Open collaboration triads may indicate an undocumented direct operational link.

question_template.it: È documentato un ruolo o partecipazione diretta di {source} in {target}, oltre al coordinamento con {bridge}?
question_template.en: Is a direct role or participation of {source} in {target} documented beyond coordination with {bridge}?

rules.rationale: Operational coordination with an event participant justifies checking direct involvement in the event.

rules.condition: Must ask only about financial/beneficial interest, never asserting operational control (PK-06C).

question_template.it: Il finanziamento di {source} verso {bridge} comporta un interesse beneficiario o patrimoniale documentato in {target}?
question_template.en: Does {source}'s funding of {bridge} involve a documented financial or beneficial interest in {target}?

rules.rationale: Funding + ownership may warrant financial-beneficial verification without inferring operational control.

rules.condition: Requires independent corroboration beyond single authority attribution.

question_template.it: Esistono riscontri indipendenti sull'attribuzione di {source} riguardante il controllo di {bridge} su {target}?
question_template.en: Is there independent corroboration for {source}'s attribution regarding {bridge}'s control over {target}?

rules.rationale: Authority attribution combined with control requires independent corroboration.

rules.condition: PK-06C non-forcing rule: funding does not imply operational control.

question_template.it: VIETATO: il finanziamento non implica controllo.
question_template.en: FORBIDDEN: funding does not imply control.

rules.condition: PK-06C non-forcing rule: co-presence does not imply collaboration.

question_template.it: VIETATO: la compresenza non implica collaborazione.
question_template.en: FORBIDDEN: co-presence does not imply collaboration.

rules.condition: PK-06C non-forcing rule: participation does not imply collaboration.

question_template.it: VIETATO: la partecipazione non implica collaborazione.
question_template.en: FORBIDDEN: participation does not imply collaboration.

rules.condition: PK-06C non-forcing rule: accusation does not establish commission.

question_template.it: VIETATO: l'accusa non stabilisce il mandato.
question_template.en: FORBIDDEN: accusation does not establish commission.

rules.condition: PK-06C non-forcing rule: political support does not imply coordination.

question_template.it: VIETATO: il sostegno politico non implica coordinamento.
question_template.en: FORBIDDEN: political support does not imply coordination.

rules.condition: PK-06C non-forcing rule: accusation does not establish control.

question_template.it: VIETATO: l'accusa non stabilisce il controllo.
question_template.en: FORBIDDEN: accusation does not establish control.
